method: Read all five pinned files; verified each Git blob identity and recorded SHA256. Upstream tests not executed.
findings: Collision resistance test generates 1048576 distinct integer payloads and checks footer duplicate count across checksum algorithms, explicitly excluding paranoid. It detects accidental collisions but does not force a full digest collision or assert byte-based partition membership.

Large-file test compares two equal 10000 KiB files against a one-byte mismatch 10 KiB from the end, asserting duplicate count only. Separate hash utility test creates 5 GiB sparse files, changes the final byte and compares metro hashes; it skips when initial sparse-file allocation uses blocks.
Sparse paranoid test creates 1352 files of 256 MiB with 676 content pairs and asserts 676 duplicates. Despite its memory-limiter description it records no memory high-water mark or enforced ceiling.

Small-difference tests distinguish first/last and mirrored offsets, positive identical controls and one-byte negatives. Hardlink tests check reported reclaimable space, including links outside the scanned subtree.

Clamp tests intentionally identify files differing outside the selected range. They check absolute and fractional boundaries and empty ranges. Such equivalence must stay distinct from whole-file equality in our library.
limits: No upstream runtime or memory claim validated.
Review progress is 55 of 289 files, not a complete repository review.
